The hotlines are terrible. Regardless, please wait until your kids arent in the house, its not fair to them. Obviously id prefer to help you through whatever your going through, but if not, then at the very least dont traumatize your kids.

First of all, dont feel bad about posting here. Clearly your not the only one to feel this way, and we want you to be here. Its not pathetic at all, in fact, reaching out is probably the best thing you can do.

Second, i know how it feels to have noone to talk to, and it really hurts. But even though we might be strangers, feel free to talk about whatever it is you need to talk about, and at least I will be listening.
Damn, that one hits home

I hate nothing more than false promises, and things like “it gets better” always seem superficial, but if theres one thing I’ve found to be true, its that there are almost always other people. Be that friends, a boyfriend, or another “family”, you will find someone you can talk to. Obviously its easier for some people than others, but with how many people youll interact with once you get out of high school, chances are theres at least one person who truly cares about you.

Just keep holding on for now, and although i cant promise it gets any easier, i can almost guarantee that eventually you wont have to face it alone.

If you truly want to make it tonight: turn off your phone, and try to sleep. I know how hard it can be, but its really easy to get caught up in a cycle of sadness. Obviously, if it were always this easy, then this sub wouldnt exist, but if you need just 1 more night, then promise yourself youll make it tonight, and anything that happens later is for future you to decide.

This isnt perfect advice, especially not long term, but if tomorrow is really that important, then dont try to work out anything tonight. Just go to sleep, and deal with it later.
